title: production: one branch, and a theOS check
quote: I set the environment production to deploy from the branch production only, and added a required check named theOS to production's ruleset.
means: The environment production deploys only from the branch production. production's ruleset now requires the check theOS beside Only from main and avenSANDBOX; nothing merges into production until all three report. avenSANDBOX's check leaves at aip-59ad's Gate B, and theOS is pinned to GitHub Actions once it has reported.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-f6da that held
